description: Land Acquisition - Mathugobe, Kotapola D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired for public purpose, including location details, survey information, boundaries, and ownership/leaseholder information. It contains a formal notice of acquisition and procedures for compensation claims, which falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined for Type 4 (Land Gazettes). There is no government personnel or structural content that would trigger Types 1-3.
